digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer module and config schema
propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is inert with zero production read sites outside config plumbing; the per-language analyzer dispatch it enabled was never wired and is now obsolete.
The analyzer registry seam was designed in epic 839b but intentionally shipped empty; the required wiring in story 0734 never happened and was bypassed for a single language-agnostic LOC analyzer.
Story c23c-c32b-982c-4196 retired the dispatch design in favor of direct composition but did not execute its conditional removal clause; this ticket removes that dead code.

The dispatch was not viable as designed: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze with keyword parameter 'languages' but scc_loc.analyze names its second parameter 'scan_roots', causing TypeError at runtime.
Removal requires adding tombstone entries to _TOMBSTONE_REGISTRY for cfg code_health.analyzers and env REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ANALYZERS to prevent silent config drops.
